## Checklist

- [ ] `cmake --workflow --preset ci` passes locally (warnings are errors there)
- [ ] Tests cover the change (or it cannot be tested, and the reason is above)
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` is clean (formatting, cmake-lint)
- [ ] The docs (README, wiki) describe the new behaviour
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]`
